events.title: Field Day Sydney 2026
events.summary: Field Day’s New Year’s Day edition at The Domain featured a dance-heavy lineup led by Carl Cox, Jamie Jones, Deborah de Luca, Patrick Mason and STÜM, with The Presets and Bag Raiders also listed.

events.title: THE WORKS feat. I Hate Models, VTSS, sim0ne, MASSI
events.summary: Part of THE WORKS warehouse series at Carriageworks, this night paired I Hate Models with VTSS, sim0ne and MASSI for a hard-edged techno program.

events.title: THE WORKS feat. Marc Rebillet, A-Trak, Young Franco, Madame Reve
events.summary: THE WORKS brought Marc Rebillet’s loop-based live show to Carriageworks with A-Trak, Young Franco and Madame Reve on support.

events.title: Petting Zoo feat. Laidlaw, Jordan Brando, PARKER, Locky, Known Artist, NewTone
events.summary: Sydney’s Petting Zoo party moved indoors to Plaza Hotel with Laidlaw, Locky, KnownArtist, Jordan Brando, James Parker and NewTone among the listed lineup.

events.title: Hot Chip: Joy in Repetition + Haiku Hands
events.summary: Hot Chip played two Sydney Festival nights at the Sydney Opera House Concert Hall, supported by Haiku Hands, around the band’s Joy in Repetition greatest-hits era.

events.title: The Lumineers — The Automatic World Tour
events.summary: The Lumineers brought their AUTOMATIC World Tour to Qudos Bank Arena as part of their Australia and New Zealand run.

events.title: Tom Odell — Wonderful Life Tour
events.summary: Tom Odell’s Wonderful Life Tour stopped at Hordern Pavilion, with Them & I listed as support.

events.title: Dangerous Goods XXL Sydney
events.summary: Dangerous Goods XXL took over Carriageworks with Boris Brejcha, Timmy Trumpet, Moritz Hofbauer, Pretty Pink and KAYA across a techno and hardstyle-focused bill.

events.title: Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds — The Wild God Tour
events.summary: Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds’ Wild God Tour played outdoor Domain shows on 23 and 24 January, marking the band’s first Australia and New Zealand dates since 2017.

events.title: HTID 2026
events.summary: HSU’s HTID 2026 returned to Sydney Showground with two venue areas: the HTID Main Stage and The Klassics Stage, focused on happy hard, hardstyle, raw and classics.

events.title: Australia Day Live 2026
events.summary: Australia Day Live was a free ticketed Sydney Opera House Forecourt concert with listed performers including Kate Ceberano, William Barton, Cody Simpson, Harts, The Fabulous Caprettos and John Foreman’s Australian Pops Orchestra.

events.title: Peggy Gou — Australia 2026
events.summary: Untitled Group presented Peggy Gou for an exclusive Sydney show at Carriageworks, supported by Bryson Hill, Ayebatonye and Mimi J.
